title: File:"We Are Here" mural, Commonwealth Avenue at Hertel Avenue, Buffalo, New York - 20210509.jpg
author: Andre Carrotflower
description: As seen on a rainy afternoon in May 2021, the mural on the Commonwealth Avenue side of the building at 1256 Hertel Avenue in the North Park section of Buffalo, New York is entitled We Are Here. It was commissioned in 2018 by the Albright-Knox Art Gallery's public art program and designed and painted by local small-business owner Brian Grunert.
